data.title: 猫猫 · 海滨药草茶的苦味研究
data.description: 【海港药草市场·午后】猫猫穿着深绿色泳装外搭短披肩，坐在海边摊位前研究一杯冷泡药草茶；她尝过后皱眉，又加了一片柑橘，把调好的杯子推向镜头，蓝瞳里全是“这次可以了”的认真。
data.location: harbor herb market by the sea
data.action: 海港摊位试喝冷泡药草茶，调好苦味后把成品推向镜头
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on glass and green leaves
data.mood: 把假日也做成一场药理研究
data.promptProse: Maomao from The Apothecary Diaries wears a deep green swimsuit with a short cream cape, herb pouch and a glass of chilled citrus herbal tea. She sits at the harbor herb stall comparing a chilled tea with citrus peel and dried leaves. She frowns at the first taste, adjusts the balance, and pushes the improved glass toward the viewer with the focused satisfaction of a successful field experiment. clear afternoon light on glass and green leaves.
